subject: Engagement kickoff & evaluation brief — Astrum Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasper Allen <jasper.allen@astrumhealth.com>, Nina Rao <nina.rao@astrumhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement kickoff & evaluation brief — Astrum Health

Hi Jasper / Nina —

Thanks again for taking the intro call today. Very excited by the potential fit between Redwood Inference and Astrum's clinical summarization workflow. Per our discussion, I captured a concise evaluation brief and a proposed kickoff timeline so we can move to a short trial that proves the two core success criteria you highlighted.

Quick recap (from today's discovery):
- Primary use case: automated discharge-summary generation and extractive QA for physician notes.
- Success criteria: (1) clinical summarization F1/ROUGE baseline improvement vs current rule-based pipeline (target: >= 18% relative), and (2) end-to-end latency for batch nightly processing under 120s per patient record at target throughput.
- Data scope: 6 months of de-identified discharge notes, ~20k records for evaluation.
- Compliance/hosting: must run in a VPC (private deployment) during the trial and align with our SOC2 evidence requirements.

Proposed evaluation plan (high level):
1) Kickoff & data prep (1 week): we confirm data access method, share ingestion checklist, and provision a private trial environment.
2) Baseline run (1 week): you provide a 2k sample set; we run Redwood's inference pipeline and produce metric comparisons.
3) Iteration & tuning (2 weeks): model variants, quantization/latency tuning, prefix caching for common templates.
4) Final validation & handoff (1 week): summarize results, run a 2k holdout, and document recommended deployment profile.

Mutual action items I propose today:
- Astrum: provide de-identified sample (2k) and confirm SFTP/VPC access point by Tue 6/23.
- Redwood: provision a private trial environment and deliver baseline run within 5 business days of data receipt.
- Both: agree on evaluation notebook and metric slice definitions (clinical vs administrative notes).

Suggested timeline: kickoff next Monday (6/22) with a 5-week engagement to decision. If that works, I'll send a short engagement agreement and a trial config (attached).

Attachments: astrum_eval_outline_v1.pdf (evaluation plan), redwood_trial_config.yaml (proposed infra configs), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (SLA and supported rollback policies).

Open items: procurement contact for commercial approvals and any internal reviewers for privacy/compliance evidence.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m follow-up if you prefer to walk the plan.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Jasper Allen <jasper.allen@astrumhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Rao <nina.rao@astrumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement kickoff & evaluation brief — Astrum Health

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns well with our internal readouts. A few clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: the 18% relative improvement is a good target — our clinical leads will want the detailed metric definitions (precision/recall/F1 by ICD subtype). We can share the annotation schema by EOW.
- Latency: the 120s per record target is for a nightly batch of ~1,000 records; for interactive physician checks the soft target is <2s per single record (we understand tradeoffs).
- Data & compliance: procurement will need a brief (1-2 page) security appendix and evidence list before we provide SFTP credentials.

On timeline: we can target kickoff 6/22, but procurement review may push data deliverable to 6/25. If Redwood can begin environment provisioning this week (even with test data), that would help speed things.

Procurement contact: procurement@astrumhealth.com (looping separately). I copied Nina (Clinical PM) who will own metric sign-off.

Jasper
Director, Clinical Innovation | Astrum Health
jasper.allen@astrumhealth.com | (617) 555-0912

Thanks Ben — happy to own the security appendix and the kickoff logistics. A couple of quick notes from an operations angle:

- Deployment pattern: for speed-to-results I recommend VPC-hosted private deployment with a small dedicated GPU pool (NVIDIA T4x2 equivalent). That meets your SOC2 needs and gets us throughput without appliance installation. If Astrum requires on-prem we can pivot but that adds ~2 weeks.
- Security appendix: I'll attach a one-page appendix (SAA-astrum-6-16.pdf) into the shared doc today covering account separation, KMS approach, and audit log retention.
- Kickoff invite: Ben, I'll send a calendar invite for 6/22 10:00 AM PT and include a short agenda (data access, metric sign-off owners, ingestion checklist).

Forwarding next steps to procurement and Nina for visibility. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Marissa Cole
